title: Discovering Topics from Linear Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.34739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear recommenders and topic models are similar in that they implicitly learn from co-occurrences of items. However, there has been little study of how these two model families are related. In this work, we show that, under a latent-factor model of the user-item interactions, the latent topics can be discovered from the weight matrix of a closed-form linear autoencoder. These topics provide a basis for interpreting the recommendations, and can be obtained directly from the trained recommender without additional training. Building on our analysis, we further propose novel item and user normalizations that prevent popular items and very active users from dominating the topics. translated_title: 从线性自编码器中发现主题
translated_abstract: 线性推荐器和主题模型的相似之处在于它们都隐式地从物品的共现关系中学习。然而，关于这两个模型家族之间关系的研究却很少。在这项工作中，我们证明，在用户-物品交互的潜在因子模型下，潜在主题可以从闭式解线性自编码器的权重矩阵中发现。这些主题为解释推荐结果提供了基础，并且可以直接从训练好的推荐器中获取，无需额外的训练。基于我们的分析，我们进一步提出了新颖的物品和用户归一化方法，以防止热门物品和极度活跃的用户主导主题。我们在六个公开数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法获得了显著高于所有专用主题模型的主题质量，并且在所有六个数据集上匹配或超过了最好的线性自编码器，同时其推荐性能也具有竞争力。
tldr: 该论文证明潜在主题可以直接从闭式解线性自编码器的权重矩阵中提取，无需额外训练即可解释推荐结果，并通过新颖的物品和用户归一化方法实现超越专用主题模型的主题质量，同时保持有竞争力的推荐性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that latent topics can be discovered directly from the weight matrix of a closed-form linear autoencoder without additional training, and proposes novel item and user normalizations that achieve topic quality surpassing dedicated topic models while maintaining competitive recommendation performance.
